title: Your First Tour at Ocean Canyon

blocks.headline: Ninety minutes. One resort. No pressure.
lines: A guided drive through the resort
See the sites, the pool, the clubhouse
blocks.narration: Your first tour at Ocean Canyon is a ninety minute guided look at one resort. You'll see the camp sites, the pool, and the clubhouse, and you can ask anything you want.

blocks.headline: Arrive ten minutes early
lines: Check in at the welcome center
Kids and pets are welcome on the drive
blocks.narration: Plan to arrive about ten minutes early and check in at the welcome center. Bring a photo ID. Kids and pets are welcome to ride along on the drive.

blocks.headline: Running late? Just call.
lines: Your rep's number is in your confirmation text
We hold your spot for thirty minutes
blocks.narration: If you're running late, just call the number in your confirmation text. We'll hold your spot for thirty minutes, and you can reschedule once with no questions asked.

blocks.headline: What membership actually gets you
lines: Stay at any Ocean Canyon resort
blocks.narration: Membership means you can stay at any Ocean Canyon resort, book online year round, and pay one flat annual fee instead of nightly rates.

blocks.headline: The gift is yours either way
lines: Your tour gift does not depend on buying
Pick it up at the front desk after the drive
blocks.narration: The gift you were promised is yours whether or not you join. Pick it up at the front desk right after the drive.

blocks.headline: See you at the welcome center
lines: Confirm by replying YES to your text
Questions? Call or text your rep anytime
blocks.narration: That's it. Reply yes to your confirmation text, and we'll see you at the welcome center. Questions before then? Call or text your rep anytime.
